content:
nina: Heads up — Aurora (trial) reporting intermittent 429s during embed onboarding after they enabled autosync. Happening in bursts when many tabs/devices start at once. Can someone triage?

raj: Do we have their request pattern and headers? are they using ephemeral tokens or a long-lived key? :thinking:

nina: They rotate ephemeral tokens every 5m. Paste from their debug log (times are ms since epoch):
```
[2026-03-20T16:01:59.103Z] GET /v1/embeds/generate 200 ms Authorization: Bearer eph_eyJ... X-Client-Id: aurora-web
[2026-03-20T16:02:00.100Z] GET /v1/embeds/generate 429 ms Retry-After: 12
[2026-03-20T16:02:00.120Z] GET /v1/embeds/generate 429 ms Retry-After: 12
[2026-03-20T16:02:00.150Z] GET /v1/embeds/generate 429 ms Retry-After: 12
```
They showed a tight fanout around 16:02:00 when multiple clients refreshed the token and immediately prefetched embeddings.

tyler: Two likely contributors: token-rotation alignment + aggressive client prefetch. Quick mitigations:
- add jitter to token refresh (randomize refresh start +- 30s) and leader-election per browser session so only one tab fetches per user.
- honor Retry-After and exponential backoff on 429s (client-side).
- SDK config suggestion: `max_concurrent_prefetch: 4`, `prefetch_window_ms: 2000`, `refresh_jitter_ms: 30000`.

nina: Great — I'll push those as recommended changes. Also Aurora's dashboards showed edge proxy queue spikes at same time. @raj can we confirm whether onboarding/trial traffic is on the same rate-limit bucket as production embed calls?

raj: They currently share the embed-generation bucket (default 600/min per token). For ephemeral-heavy onboarding flows that leads to bursts. I'll open infra ticket to split trial onboarding tenants into a separate, higher-granularity bucket and add a short grace for ephemeral tokens. Ticket infra-789 created — assigned to eng-infra, ETA tomorrow for a draft policy.

ingress-bot: Alert: eu-west-1 shard observed 12% 429 spike for customer aurora between 2026-03-20T16:00Z and 2026-03-20T16:03Z (3m window).

nina: Thanks all. Scheduling an enablement call with Aurora tomorrow 10:00am PT to walk through the SDK patch and a quick config change. I'll send them a minimal snippet to apply and a rollback plan if they still see 429s. Will update here after call. :thumbsup:
